title: Is your political rage a spiritual problem?
text:
By David Jones III, Op-ed contributor Wednesday, July 15, 2026Unsplash/Icons8 Team
The studio lights are bright. Two guests lean across the desk, interrupting one another before either can finish a sentence. The moderator has long since lost control. Voices rise. Fingers jab across the desk. The audience applauds whenever someone lands a verbal punch. Before the hour is over, clips of the exchange are racing across social media under headlines celebrating who “destroyed” whom.
Read Full Article: https://www.christianpost.com/voices/is-your-political-rage-a-spiritual-problem.html
